description: What a machine needs installed to develop the Ikaika portal API. Read by .\script.ps1 development-setup, which installs what is missing and reports the rest. Package-level dependencies are NOT here - composer.json and package.json already declare those, and a second copy would go stale the first time somebody adds a package.

notes.scope: machine means a system-wide install that needs administrator; user means it lands in this profile and must not be installed elevated.
notes.when: A tool with a 'when' is only graded if the setup command was asked for it. Everything else always applies.
notes.versions: minVersion is a floor - this or newer. series pins a line (8.4 means any 8.4.x and never 8.5), which is what WampServer components need because a different line is a different Apache module and a different extension set.

powershell.name: PowerShell 7
powershell.for: every command in this toolkit; the scripts are PowerShell 7 only

git.name: Git
git.for: the toolkit submodule, and every branch command

vcredist.name: VC++ runtimes
vcredist.for: Apache and PHP link against these; without them WampServer starts with an orange tray icon and a dialog naming a DLL

wampserver.name: WampServer
wampserver.for: Apache, MySQL and phpMyAdmin - the stack this API is deployed on

php.name: PHP
php.for: composer.json requires php ^8.3; 8.4 is what WampServer 3.4.0 bundles and what we run

mysql.name: MySQL
mysql.for: the three product databases. WampServer 3.4.0 bundles 8.4, so 8.0 arrives as an aviatechno add-on

composer.name: Composer
composer.for: vendor/ and the autoloader. Installed from its own phar, verified against the signature Composer publishes

node.name: Node.js
node.for: the Vite asset build only. The API itself needs nothing from Node, so a machine without it is not broken

phpExtensions.description: Switched on in BOTH php.ini files WampServer ships - the one beside php.exe that the CLI reads, and Apache's. An extension on in only one produces the bug where the site works and artisan does not.
